title: One of Grusch's 40 witnesses died at a convenient time

tellings.quote: one of them is the guy who's no longer with us. Um, whose demise was was quite conveniently timed for those who might have something to do with it.

plain: One of the roughly 40 witnesses behind David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public with claims that the US holds crashed craft not made by humans, has since died. A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he flew a UFO recovery himself, tells Michels this and adds that the man's death was "quite conveniently timed" for anyone who might have had a hand in it. He does not say who or how, but the hint is that a witness may have been silenced.
